source: CCRAS evidence review + Ministry of AYUSH approved herbs

herbs.evidence_note: Multiple RCTs show 15-20% reduction in FBG. CCRAS Grade A evidence.
herbs.how_to_use: Drink 30ml fresh juice on empty stomach daily, or cook as vegetable 3x/week
herbs.how_to_use_hi: खाली पेट 30ml ताजा जूस रोज, या सब्जी के रूप में सप्ताह में 3 बार
contraindications: Hypoglycaemia risk if combined with insulin/Metformin — monitor glucose
Avoid in pregnancy
Not for children under 12

herbs.evidence_note: Clinical studies show significant reduction in systolic BP and LDL. AIIMS studies support cardioprotective use.
herbs.how_to_use: Boil 1 tsp bark powder in 1 cup milk (Arjuna Ksheerpak), drink twice daily
herbs.how_to_use_hi: 1 चम्मच छाल पाउडर को 1 कप दूध में उबालें (अर्जुन क्षीरपाक), दिन में दो बार पिएं
herbs.timing: Morning and evening, 30 min before meals
contraindications: May enhance effect of blood pressure medications — monitor BP
Consult doctor if on cardiac drugs
Avoid in pregnancy

herbs.evidence_note: ADAPTOGENS trial shows 14% cortisol reduction. Improves insulin signalling in T2DM. WHO Traditional Medicine recognised.
herbs.how_to_use: Mix 1/2 tsp powder in warm milk with honey. Or take 300mg standardised extract capsule
herbs.how_to_use_hi: आधा चम्मच पाउडर गर्म दूध में शहद के साथ मिलाएं। या 300mg एक्सट्रेक्ट कैप्सूल लें।
contraindications: Avoid with thyroid medications without monitoring
Not in pregnancy
May cause drowsiness — avoid before driving
Avoid with immunosuppressants

herbs.scientific: Terminalia chebula + T. bellirica + Emblica officinalis
herbs.evidence_note: Multiple studies show 8-12% LDL reduction. Amla (Emblica) has highest Vitamin C content of any fruit.
herbs.how_to_use: Mix 1 tsp in warm water, drink at bedtime or early morning on empty stomach
herbs.how_to_use_hi: 1 चम्मच गर्म पानी में मिलाएं, रात को सोने से पहले या सुबह खाली पेट पिएं
contraindications: May cause loose stools initially — start with small dose
Avoid large doses in pregnancy
May interact with blood thinners (Warfarin)

herbs.evidence_note: ICMR-approved evidence. Multiple clinical trials show significant glycaemic benefit. Included in AYUSH diabetes protocol.
herbs.how_to_use: Soak 1 tbsp seeds overnight, eat on empty stomach. Or add to chapati dough
herbs.how_to_use_hi: 1 बड़ा चम्मच बीज रात भर भिगोएं, खाली पेट खाएं। या चपाती के आटे में मिलाएं।
herbs.timing: Morning, empty stomach or with meals
contraindications: Hypoglycaemia risk if combined with diabetes medication — monitor glucose
Avoid excessive amounts in pregnancy (uterine stimulant)
May thin blood — avoid pre-surgery

herbs.evidence_note: WHO Monograph acknowledged. Studies show HbA1c reduction of 0.6-0.9%. Gymnemic acids block sweet taste receptors.
herbs.how_to_use: 400mg standardised extract capsule twice daily, before meals
herbs.how_to_use_hi: भोजन से पहले 400mg कैप्सूल दिन में दो बार
contraindications: Monitor blood glucose closely if on Metformin/insulin
Not for children
Avoid if blood glucose is already low

herbs.evidence_note: Used in AYUSH renal protocol. Clinical studies in diabetic nephropathy show reduced creatinine.
herbs.how_to_use: Boil 1 tsp root powder in 200ml water, reduce to half, drink twice daily
herbs.how_to_use_hi: 1 चम्मच जड़ पाउडर 200ml पानी में उबालें, आधा करें, दिन में दो बार पिएं
contraindications: Strong diuretic — may affect antihypertensive drug levels
Consult doctor if on water pills
Avoid in severe dehydration

herbs.evidence_note: CCRAS clinical study shows significant FBG reduction with fixed-oil Tulsi extract. Universal availability makes it highly practical.
herbs.how_to_use: Chew 5-10 fresh leaves every morning. Or brew 1 cup Tulsi tea daily
herbs.how_to_use_hi: हर सुबह 5-10 ताजी पत्तियाँ चबाएं। या 1 कप तुलसी चाय रोज बनाएं।
herbs.dosage: 2.5g dried leaves or 10 fresh leaves daily
contraindications: May thin blood mildly — caution before surgery
High doses in pregnancy — avoid
May reduce fertility in males at high doses (limited evidence)
